_doc: The day (T-259, gravelight/world/day_cycle.gd): one hour per round, a day every rounds_per_day rounds. `defaults`, then `maps.<map id>` over them. Round 1 is start_hour (0 = midnight: the map as authored). seconds_per_hour: how slowly the light follows a new round. noon_elevation: the sun's height at noon, degrees. *_span: sun heights (degrees) between which the day / the sun / the moon fade in or out. Colours are '#rrggbb' or [r, g, b] (linear, as in the scenes). ambient_energy_day and exposure_day are the outdoor values at noon; indoor_share is how much of the daylight the air gets under a roof, below_y the camera height under which it gets none. sky_day / sky_twilight: properties of the Environment's sky material and uniforms of the cloud domes at noon / on the horizon. from: 'match' counts the match's rounds, 'arrival' the rounds on this map (a campaign act with its own hour). Presentation only.
